Micro-batch 4 for Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-OSS 20B. Datasets on node-local NVMe (FLUX.1, DLRMv4, Llama 2, Llama 3.1, GPT-OSS); host page cache dropped before every run. Kernel settings applied per job (Slurm prolog sysctl file / job script), not by the benchmark code: DLRMv4: vm.zone_reclaim_mode=0, vm.overcommit_memory=0, transparent huge pages enabled=always, defrag=madvise. Llama 3.1, Llama 2, GPT-OSS and FLUX.1: node defaults (vm.zone_reclaim_mode=3, vm.overcommit_memory=2, transparent huge pages enabled=always, defrag=always). Exception: on 2026-10-12 around 05:00 UTC vm.overcommit_memory was set to 0 at runtime for another workload, during the last minutes of FLUX.1 run 9 and possibly part of run 10; FLUX.1 uses 2 forked data-loader workers per GPU, which fit under either setting, and its speed was unchanged in all 10 runs. Llama 3.1 8B: 11 completed runs with the submitted code and settings (1 from a first 10-run job stopped by the operator during its second run to free the node, not for its results, and 10 from a second job); the 10 consecutive runs (by start time) closest to the median were designated for scoring, per the MLPerf training rules. The interrupted run never completed.
